_comment: Games, times and JV/varsity results come from ArbiterLive (see roster.json for the team pages); scripts/build.py merges them.
MPSSAA fills in any varsity league score Arbiter is missing. Games before seasonStart (August preseason) are left off; later scrimmages show but don't count in records.

added: games Arbiter doesn't list at all (e.g. the Aug 29 Oakdale scrimmage), kept even before seasonStart "replace": true merges into the game Arbiter lists that day (e.g. a playoff game with opponent TBA), keeping its scores.

This file adds what Arbiter doesn't have: GoFan ticket links, notes and missing scores ("jv": "0-1", Walkersville first), keyed by game date, plus opponent mascots. "feature": true pins a special card for that game (e.g. Senior Night) above the recent results; "site" sets a neutral venue (e.g. the CMC final); "ticketNote" replaces the default ticket text when there is no link; "tickets": false hides the GoFan link until the event exists; "tentative": true marks the kickoff time as not final; "morePhotos": true adds "more coming soon" to the game's photo count. "titles" replaces the win-streak line under a team's record (e.g. a championship).
